name: io.github.2fizzle/bip-skills-mcp
title: BIP Skills MCP
description: Serves Agent Skills folders (SKILL.md + bundled files) to any MCP client. Bundles bip-xsl-hardening.

environmentVariables.name: SKILLS_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Extra skills folder(s), separated by ';' on Windows or ':' elsewhere. A skill found there overrides a bundled skill of the same name.

environmentVariables.name: SKILLS_NO_BUNDLED
environmentVariables.description: Optional. Set to 1 to hide the bundled skills and serve only SKILLS_DIR.
